title: mcpforge/v1 — kind: Package
description: Field for field with the worked example at 02 §6.1. A package is a SELECTION, not a build: a list of server ids and role ids that already exist in the base. additionalProperties is false BECAUSE of that — it is the structural half of 'no code, no manifests, no schemas, no transformation'. No branch of MCPForge is ever created for a customer.

servers.description: Server ids that already exist in the base. Referential integrity is W0-B2.

portal.description: Headless capability, not a commercial statement (02 §6.1).
